name: Orbit Dash
summary: Orbit Dash is a one-tap rhythm game for Android, iPhone, iPad and the web browser. Your ball circles neon orbits on its own: tap to jump between rings, dodge the spikes and grab the gems, with every move landing on the beat. Since update 3.0 you can race other players live in VERSUS LIVE: up to 8 players on one track with the same spikes and no upgrades, so only your taps decide. Invite friends with a link or room code, or race a random opponent, in the endless mode or on any music level. Handcrafted music levels like FIRST LIGHT, NEON DRIFT, HYPERLANE (160 BPM), MOSSLIGHT, FREEFALL and the organ-driven DEMON level THE LAST TOCCATA are each built on their own original track, and the camera moves with the music. There is also an endless mode with combos and boosters, weekly leaderboards for your country and the world, ball trails and skins to unlock, daily missions, and 82 languages. All music is original, so it's safe to stream.
